sentences.en: In the contest he fully displayed what ability he had.
sentences.zh: 在比赛中，他充分展现了自己有的能力。

sentences.en: Ability to operate a computer is critical for this job.
sentences.zh: 操作电脑的能力对于这份工作至关重要。

sentences.en: You did wrong in trusting too much in your ability.
sentences.zh: 你过于自信自己的能力做错了这件事。
